contract_version: 1.2.0 until GPT publishes the next atomic regeneration

sequence.title: Restricted dataset access administration
sequence.scope: Use listCityPrincipals/listDatasetGrants/grantDatasetAccess/revokeDatasetAccess to build the admin flow with reason, confirmation, forbidden/404/409 states, audit-friendly wording and live tests. Admin city access must not be presented as content access.

sequence.title: Rule-version picker
sequence.scope: Keep the current verified-id fallback, then consume GPT's canonical listRuleVersions operation after the coordinated client regeneration. Show source, expert confirmation, superseded/conflict state and never select an unusable rule silently.

sequence.title: Stock and complete cost transparency
sequence.scope: Render server StockItem and calculation cost lines with unknown distinct from zero, checked-at/source provenance, tax state, incomplete totals and stale snapshots. Do not add client formulas or infer prices.

sequence.title: Background full-calculation UX
sequence.scope: Wire startCalculation/getJob/SSE/cancel/getCalculation/getCalculationManifest when GPT enables them. Cover queued/running/retry/recovered/cancelled/partial/failed states and reload without losing the job.

sequence.title: Scenario comparison
sequence.scope: Compare immutable server snapshots only. Show differing input versions, stale flags, known/unknown totals, survival/care gaps and provenance; never compare mutable editor state as a result.

sequence.title: 3D building and planting acceptance
sequence.scope: Extend the existing 2D/3D scene using only server-provided geometry, height_m and height_basis. Missing height stays footprint/empty, not an invented extrusion. Add LOD/context-loss/touch/reduced-motion and representative real-device evidence.

sequence.title: Frontend regression and handoff
sequence.scope: Keep generated client drift, typecheck, unit/build/audit, visual desktop/mobile/dark and disposable live API checks green; update CLAUDE handoff and shared STATUS after every integration-ready increment.

ownership_rules: Claude does not edit canonical contracts, migrations or server formulas.
GPT announces an exact contract SHA before Claude regenerates the client.
All synthetic browser inputs remain explicitly labelled SYNTHETIC TEST.

Use all admitted licensed public/research sources in the working map and 3D scene. Primary map, 3D, feature and scenario screens do not show unverified/source labels. Preserve provenance in API manifests and the administrative data view; show a blocking gap only when safety, approval or an authoritative calculation depends on it.
Do not claim official boundaries, exact networks, local calibration or accepted ecological coefficients before organizer data passes intake.
